# simi bharaj
ui/ux design engineer. ai design & development. simplifying complex systems. tampa.

i simplify complex systems. i help businesses tidy and optimize their workflows.

## numbers
- 90+ builds shipped
- 66 custom websites for tampa businesses
- 60+ ai agents and workflows built and run
- 1,000+ hours building with ai
- 24,000+ prompts written and tested
- 210+ newsletter subscribers
- 7+ years in healthcare sales

## builds
1. bella: a healthcare outreach agent built from doing the job and training people to do it. she calls, follows up and books the demo. https://gethealthcarebdr.com/
2. one patient: microsoft says its ai out-diagnoses doctors, so i ran their benchmark myself on gpt-5 and built a 3d body map of one case. tap an organ to see what the ai ordered and what it missed. https://simibharaj.me/one-patient/
3. alien vs printer: the brand, the website and the sales side of a 3d print company i hold equity in. https://alienvsprinter.com/
4. 66 local business sites: custom websites for tampa businesses, each one tuned for design, seo and ai search.
5. imaging scout: a parts-sourcing agent for my dad's medical imaging business. it finds the part, gets the quotes and flags what needs a human yes. https://ecotechmed.com
6. ai, in my opinion: a weekly essay, plus a newsletter you can play. each edition is its own interactive build.
7. the rep dashboard: a dashboard i designed at pfizer so reps could measure their own performance. it drove adoption of an ai targeting tool across the us branded field force.
8. tap cards tampa: tap-to-review nfc cards. i priced it, ran the launch research, ranked the prospects and designed the print set. https://tapcardstampa.com/
9. training wheels: a next-sentence copilot for insurance calls, built from 35 transcripts of my own training. https://simibharaj.me/work/training-wheels.webp
10. the revenue desk: the crm i built for my nfc business. prospects, campaigns and the daily report in one app. https://simibharaj.me/work/revenue-desk.webp
11. the usage archive: every prompt and hour i've put into ai since june 2025, turned into a dashboard. https://simibharaj.me/ai-usage-archive/dashboard/
12. retirement income calculator: a calculator i coded myself that shows where retirement income actually comes from. https://simibharaj.me/retirement-income-calculator/
13. audits & market research: website and seo audits for tampa businesses, plus market research built from county records.

## code
- healthcare-bdr-agent (JavaScript): voice plus an email sequence engine for healthcare outreach. https://github.com/simibharaj/healthcare-bdr-agent
- lead-pipeline-orchestrator (TypeScript): normalizes and scores messy inbound leads into clean crm records. https://github.com/simibharaj/lead-pipeline-orchestrator
- agent-structured-output-validator (Python): checks model output against a schema and re-prompts with the errors. https://github.com/simibharaj/agent-structured-output-validator
- parametric-3d-cad-library (Python): parametric models as code, with printability checks. https://github.com/simibharaj/parametric-3d-cad-library
